name: Swain
title: The Noxian Grand General

passive.name: Ravenous Flock

description.normalized: Swain collects Soul Fragments when Visions of Empire and Nevermore hit enemy champions, and also when they die. Soul Fragments heal for 3% / 3.5% / 4% / 4.5% (+0.5% AP) health and provide 16 maximum health.

passive.rawParsedText:
Swain collects Soul Fragments when Visions of Empire and Nevermore hit enemy champions, and also when they die.

Soul Fragments heal for 3% / 3.5% / 4% / 4.5% (+0.5% AP) health and provide 16 maximum health.

q.name: Death's Hand

description.normalized: Swain extends his demonic arm to launch eldritch bolts at enemies, dealing 55 / 90 / 125 / 160 (+32% AP) magic damage to enemies within range. Each bolt after the first deals 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 (+12% AP) magic damage (up to 110 damage).

q.rawParsedText:

Each bolt after the first deals 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 (+12% AP) magic damage (up to 110 damage).

w.name: Vision of Empire

description.normalized: Swain summons a demonic eye that explodes after a short delay, dealing 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+55% AP) magic damage slowing by 30% / 40% / 50% / 60% for 2.5 seconds and revealing targets hit for 4 seconds. If Vision of Empire damages an immobilized champion it will critically strike for 50% damage. Champions hit will give 1 soul fragment.

e.name: Nevermove

description.normalized: Swain launches a demonic wave that deals 35 / 85 / 135 / 185 (+25% AP) magic damage to enemies along the way, then turns back after reaching the furthest distance, dealing 35 / 50 / 6+5 / 80 (+25% AP) magic daamge to the area and rooting enemies withing the area for 1.5 seconds. Recast: Swain pulls the rooted champions to himself and collets 1 Soul Fragment from targets.

r.name: Demonic Ascension

description.normalized: Swain frees the demon, dealing 10 / 25 / 45 (+15% AP)magic damage per second to enemies within his range and restoring 20 / 30 / 40 (+20% AP) health to himself. Recast: Can be cast again after 2 seconds of Demonic Ascension, dealing damage and slowing enemies.
